title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Billing a Visit Performed Beyond the Term's Visits
content:
## Billing desk entry

Where a visit under a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record was performed beyond the visits the term carried, the building owner is billed for it. The charge is tied to the work order the visit was performed under, attached to the invoice the owner is billed on, stamped with the current billing month, and raises the amount the owner owes under the agreement by the amount booked.

### How the charge is booked

The desk unlocks the agent-side tool `charge_extra_visit_764307e1` and calls it. One call books a single charge of that kind against the named agreement.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | the reference number of the preventive maintenance agreement record the charge is booked against | an identifier, read from the maintenance agreement lookup before the call |
| `work_order_ref` | the work order number the visit was performed under, copied from the completion entry in the agreement's history | `WO-` followed by 7 digits |
| `invoice_ref` | the invoice number the charge is attached to, copied from the instalment entry it belongs to in the agreement's history; the office raises no new invoice number for this charge | `INV-` followed by 8 digits |
| `charge_amount_usd` | the money amount billed | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the cent; an amount of zero is accepted and books a zero charge |

### Return

The call returns a one-line confirmation naming the reference number of the charge entry created, the agreement it was booked against, the work order it was tied to, the invoice it was attached to and the amount billed in USD to two decimal places. That line is issued only when the charge has been written and the agreement's outstanding balance has been raised; it is the receipt of completion.

### Observable effect

Afterwards the charge appears in the agreement's history and the agreement's outstanding balance is higher by exactly the amount booked.
